title: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter
responsibility: Execute exact-model Claude Code or Codex CLI module tasks, exposing public results and structured quota rejection without transporting provider keys.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.constructor.execute
inputs.description: An optional executor callback that receives the generated command and task input and resolves to a process result. Defaults to taskProcess.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command.selection
inputs.description: Selects Claude Code or Codex and carries the model and intelligence strings used to build the CLI invocation. The type has exactly provider, model and intelligence fields.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run.input
inputs.description: Carries the task selection, working-directory path, prompt and AbortSignal; cwd sets the child working directory and prompt is sent to stdin. The signal is checked before spawn and aborts the child, while execution kills the process after 900,000 ms or when stdout exceeds 8,000,000 characters.

inputs.name: taskProcess.command
inputs.description: An ordered executable and argument list passed to child_process.spawn; element zero is the executable and the remaining strings are arguments.

inputs.name: taskProcess.input
inputs.description: Carries the task selection, working-directory path, prompt and AbortSignal; cwd sets the child working directory and prompt is sent to stdin. The signal is checked before spawn and aborts the child, while execution kills the process after 900,000 ms or when stdout exceeds 8,000,000 characters.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.command
outputs.description: Returns the executable and arguments for the selected provider, using the supplied model and intelligence strings. Claude uses stream-json output with acceptEdits permission mode, while Codex uses JSON output, workspace-write sandboxing and the openai provider setting.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskRunnerAdapter.run
outputs.description: Returns the selected provider, model and intelligence with public task text, reported model and usage. Text is limited to the last 16,000 characters, and reportedModel is null when the CLI does not report one.

outputs.name: taskProcess
outputs.description: Resolves with the child exit code and captured stdout; a null exit code is converted to 1. It rejects if stdout exceeds 8,000,000 characters.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Failed CLI results, quota or permission rejection, model mismatch, child-process or output-limit failures, and executor failures can throw or reject with an Error. Aborts propagate the input signal's reason.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Malformed non-empty stdout lines fail JSON.parse before provider result handling.
